entities.summary: Brent James Livermore OAM is a field hockey midfielder from Australia. He was first selected in the Australian team in 1997, and was awarded the Kookaburras player of the year award in 2001. He was also nominated of the FIH Player of the Year awards in 2002 and 2005. He has played over 300 matches for the Australian team, and has scored 30 international goals. He plays for the NSW Waratahs in the Australian Hockey League. Brent Livermore was a athletes & competitors from Grafton (b. 1976-07-05, Grafton). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
